text:
anika: Quick check — can we formalize milestone gates for the MVP cutoff and v1 rollout? We keep drifting on what's 'ship-ready'.

sam: Agree. Need clear QA/pass criteria + rollback rule. Today's sync felt fuzzy.

elaine: +1. Proposed minimal gate: feature toggle in prod off, automated smoke pass, <1% error spike, customer opt-in for canary. If any fail -> rollback.

mohit (eng): Practically we need SLOs: 95th latency target, error-rate threshold, and perf bench against staging. Also dependency list: auth, billing, routing.

rui (qa): Draft gate checklist:
```
- End-to-end happy path tests (smoke): 100%
- Regression suite: 90% pass (non-flaky)
- Latency perf: p95 <= 350ms
- Error rate: <= 0.5% over 30m
- Canary cohort health: 10 customers for 24h
```

oliver (pm): I like numeric thresholds. Can we make acceptance automated so rollbacks are automatic on violation? Deployment team prefers manual for first canary.

sam: Manual for first canary, automatic for later ones. Also need documented rollback plan: tag, revert, DB migrations reversible.

anika: On scope: which feature flags count toward MVP vs v1? I propose: conversational core + embeddings + basic user limits = MVP. Everything else goes to v1.

elaine: Customer asks (ACME pilot) want tenant SSO in MVP. That breaks the scope. Recommend pilot opt-in bucket, not global.

mohit: If SSO goes to opt-in, we need migration rollback checks. Also ensure token mapping reversible.

rui: Add monitoring hooks: alert to #incidents and an automated runbook link in the deploy message.

oliver: Decision: finalize gate checklist in doc by EOD Friday. Can someone own rollbacks runbook?

sam: I'll own rollback runbook. I'll post draft this afternoon.

anika: Thanks — ping me @sam when draft up. We'll lock MVP list in Monday's PRD update.

deploy-bot: ci/cd deploy started for canary group 1 — build 2026.03.21-782

sam: noted, feel free to cancel if smoke fails.
